title: Gas Thermometer Principle
description: Essential Criteria - The principle of the constant-volume gas thermometer must accurately describe the relationship between gas pressure and temperature at constant volume.

title: Gas Thermometer Usefulness

title: Thermocouple Principle
description: Essential Criteria - The principle of the thermocouple thermometer must correctly explain the change in thermoelectric motive force with temperature.

title: Thermocouple Usefulness
description: Essential Criteria - The usefulness of the thermocouple thermometer should mention its wide measurement range.

title: Thermistor Principle
description: Essential Criteria - The principle of the thermistor thermometer must accurately describe temperature measurement through resistance.

title: Thermistor Usefulness
description: Essential Criteria - The usefulness of the thermistor thermometer should highlight its high precision over a wide range.

title: Missing Details
description: Pitfall Criteria - Failing to include specific temperature ranges or constants in the thermocouple explanation may lead to loss of points.

title: Clarity and Conciseness
